title: Geospatial Mapping of Otitis Media (OM) and Social Determinants in Remote Northern Territory Communities
summary: NT Health proposes model-based disease-pattern analysis to guide ear-health services.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The proposed analysis combines a Bayesian hierarchical model and Power BI AI features to infer ear-disease patterns from health and social data in the Northern Territory. Existing mapping and seasonal DAX rules are conventional data-processing functions. The intended AI contribution is improved identification of areas needing services. The AI implementation is not fully specified, and resulting care improvements are unreported.
purpose: Use model-assisted disease-pattern analysis to guide targeted ear-health services.

ratings.reason: Model-assisted identification of high-risk areas is intended. Resulting planning or service improvements have not been established.
Improved hearing or care through model-guided targeting is intended, with no resulting patient outcome reported.
Reduced Indigenous health disparities are intended downstream effects of model-guided intervention.
